breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting Neumann and Dirichlet boundary conditions. It resolved the conflict by keeping the Neumann condition and explicitly stating that the Dirichlet condition was an error to be ignored. This matches the ground truth, which removed the conflicting Dirichlet condition entirely.
